summary: Phase 1 Device Discovery / Anlagen-Doku fully verified. Backend: 8 new HTTP-level pytest cases cover POST /api/devices/discover-all (4 devices, field counts 5/5/3/3, status=demo, non-empty values), POST /api/devices/{key}/discover for each of shelly/ahoy/trucki/victron (correct labels incl. Modellkennung/MAC-Adresse/Geräte-ID/Phasen-Profil/Firmware-Version for shelly, detected_at ISO ts), 404 on unknown key, GET /api/devices/info returning persisted docs with status=demo+detected_at+fields. All 8 tests PASS. Frontend (/geraete): All 4 device cards render with data-testid device-row-<key>, doc-toggle-<key>, btn-discover-<key>, plus header btn-discover-all. Clicking Erkennen on Shelly auto-expands panel, shows Demo status badge, 'zuletzt erkannt' timestamp, and renders Modellkennung/MAC-Adresse etc. Toggle on Ahoy expands then collapses doc-fields-ahoy. 'Alle erkennen' populates status/time for all 4 cards. After full page reload, GET /api/devices/info rehydrates status badges and timestamps for all devices. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: routes._save_device_info: on status=='error' the overwritten doc intentionally omits 'ip' from existing (reset to current attempt ip) and preserves fields/detected_at – matches spec of 'last-known values retained'. Behavior cannot be exercised in cloud (demo always wins), already acknowledged in request.
discovery.discover_device returns status='error' for unknown key but routes raises 404 before reaching it – unknown-key branch in orchestrator is effectively dead code (defensive, acceptable).
Devices.jsx DEVICES array is defined inside module scope (good), useEffects use empty deps – initial load correct; no refetch after save, but config save does not touch discovery data so acceptable.
seed_data_creation: device_info collection populated via discover-all during tests (demo data, idempotent upserts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 discovery feature verified end-to-end. New test file: /app/backend/tests/test_discovery_endpoints.py (HTTP). Pre-existing /app/backend/tests/test_discovery.py (unit) also still passes. Demo_mode remained True throughout. Live-mode error-retention path is untestable in cloud and was skipped per request.
